name: Бюджет
description:
Problem B — Бюджет
Contest: 2017-2018 Цикл интернет-олимпиад. Четвертая командная олимпиада, базовый уровень (26 ноября 2017 года)

You are given a competitive programming problem requiring efficient evaluation under strict time and memory constraints.
The problem requires computing the optimal result using Binary Search over the given input data.

Determine the optimal answer for each test case or query as specified below.
input_specification:
The first line contains an integer $T$ ($1 \le T \le 10^4$), representing the number of test cases (or $N$ for single-test problems).
The first line of each test case contains integers $N$ ($1 \le N \le 2 \times 10^5$) and additional parameters.
The second line contains $N$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_N$ ($1 \le a_i \le 10^9$).
output_specification:
For each test case, output the calculated answer on a single line.
If multiple valid solutions exist, output any of them. If the result can be large, compute it modulo $10^9 + 7$ (or $998244353$).
approach_summary: Apply Binary Search to maintain optimal invariant under contest constraints.

topic_editorial.title: Editorial: gym_101618_B — Бюджет [33. Binary Search]
topic_editorial.key_invariant: The predicate function $P(x)$ ('Is answer $\le x$ feasible?') is monotonic: if $P(x)$ is true for some value, it remains true for all larger values (or vice versa). This allows binary division of the answer search space $[\text{low}, \text{high}]$ in $O(\log(\text{Range}))$.
topic_editorial.complexity_analysis:
- **Time Complexity:** $\mathcal{O}(N \log(\text{Range}))$
  The binary search divides the search interval by 2 at each iteration, requiring $\log_2(\text{Range})$ steps. In each step, the feasibility check `check(mid)` scans the array in $\mathcal{O}(N)$ time.
- **Space Complexity:** $\mathcal{O}(1)$ auxiliary space
  The algorithm operates directly over the input array without allocating extra auxiliary memory.
